do not represent this external administrative cleanup as an R3 lifecycle receipt or native evidence

attach HEAD to the exact required local branch ref
verify origin and live remote, direct commit/tree equality, ancestry, clean index, and zero untracked paths
do not build, install, or create evidence artifacts inside the source mirror
preserve the source mirror for a fresh official evidence attempt

any mutation of the protected checkout or meta worktree
any Lima instance other than the exact canonical substrate instance
